scope: All units read: text for sense, translation and word glosses against the text. The text was not compared with the source page. The repeated śānti verse (flag X-DUP) is intended.

items.issue: The word gloss followed Śaṅkara (devāḥ = the senses, apaḥ plain “waters”) while the translation had “the gods” and “all activity”; the two did not agree.
items.change: Glosses now give the plain sense and note Śaṅkara’s reading.

items.issue: krato was “O mind” in the words and “O will” in the translation.
